about_the_game:
Melan – a relaxing slice of life experience!

Nothing more than a story about someone’s day.
With notes that rise, and notes that fall.
Pain is inevitable, yet suffering remains a choice of our own. 

Time drifts in an endless spiral, carrying us through the rhythm of repeated days. Yet every dawn unveils a new hue: fleeting emotions, sudden encounters, quiet surprises.

In Melan, you step into what seems like an ordinary day in the life of An – a tale woven from everyday moments and subtle psychology. And there, you may come to realize that even the simplest fragments of life can hold a hidden depth.

 We hope that Melan can bring you a piece of emotion – perhaps small, perhaps fleeting, but something that stays with you.

 

Key Features

  • Gentle slice-of-life experience
    A glimpse into school days — where teenage love, adolescent struggles, and even the smallest of moments come together to form a memorable day.

  • Atmospheric storytelling through subtle details
    No epic battles, no grand adventures. The story unfolds in quiet moments, evoking emotions from the simplicity of everyday life.

  • A personal and reflective journey
    With audio crafted for each moment, every scene resonates with the character’s emotions. Players are free to reflect, connect, and find their own meaning within the story.

  • Discover through interaction
    The narrative gradually reveals itself as you explore the environment, interact with characters, and piece together fragments that shape the bigger picture.

    Gameplay

    Melan is a narrative-driven experience where the story gradually unfolds as you explore, interact with the environment, and connect with NPCs. No pressure, no rush — just a gentle, introspective journey through a slice of life.

content_descriptors.notes: The game has some words that refer to problems, suicide, and depression

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: intel corei5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: In Melan, the player as An will go everywhere and collect memories, thereby revealing some of what is happening in the game. The game is built in a storytelling format with situations that the player gradually discovers through interacting with the environment and NPCs.
